_comment: Registers the delegation-prompt hook against the Copilot MCP bridge's tools. Installed to .claude/settings.json in the target project by setup-project.sh. The matcher assumes the bridge is registered as MCP server 'copilot' (per this project's README: `claude mcp add --transport stdio copilot -- node ...`), giving tool names mcp__copilot__copilot and mcp__copilot__copilot_reply. If the bridge is registered under a different server name, update the matcher to match — the hook script itself matches by tool-name suffix and does not need to change. The command assumes the hook runs with the project root as its working directory; if the hook does not fire, replace the relative path with an absolute one and check with /hooks.
